stem.text: The velocity of an object changes from an initial velocity $u$ to a final velocity $v$. The vectors represent these velocities.

stem.alt: Two vector arrows: a horizontal arrow to the right labelled u, and a vertical arrow pointing down labelled v.

stem.text: Which single vector represents the change in velocity of the object?

A.alt: Arrow pointing up and to the right.

B.alt: Arrow pointing down and to the right.

C.alt: Arrow pointing down and to the left.

D.alt: Arrow pointing up and to the left.
